caveat: Published 20 July 2026, outside the window. Delphi plus two illustrative STEAM cases, so the framework is expert-endorsed rather than tested against student learning.
title: Transdisciplinary Practices in Higher Education
why: Eight transdisciplinary epistemic practices grouped into exploring, meaning making and critiquing, refined with faculty through a Delphi process. A ready-made vocabulary for what you call professional criticality in transdisciplinary teaching.
